# SinSR / ResShift code

Copied from the official repositories of SinSR (Wang et al., CVPR 2024,
https://github.com/wyf0912/SinSR) and ResShift (Yue et al., NeurIPS 2023,
https://github.com/zsyOAOA/ResShift), whose `ldm/` modules come from latent diffusion. Used by
`models/sinsr.py` to build the single-step SinSR model.
